{"translations": ["I brought three bags, all of the best from the back mountain."]}
{"translations": ["The barrier cracked another seam last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink."]}

{"translations": ["Before the words had fully left his mouth, Moqi Jing came racing up from the foot of the mountain.", "Panting, he said that a young woman was lying by the roadside at the foot of the mountain."]}
{"translations": ["Lift him up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing elixir."]}
{"translations": ["Wan Qi Jing rushed into the hall carrying an unconscious woman on his back, the iron tag at his waist engraved with: Qiu Shuang."]}
{"translations": ["The wound isn't serious, it's just that his spiritual energy is exhausted. Just feed him a Spirit-Restoring Pill."]}

{"translations": ["Wan Qi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran back toward the foot of the mountain."]}
{"translations": ["Jie Xuan stood at the palace gate, his sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for a moment."]}
{"translations": ["Elder Qin, it has been a long time. I have come at the order of the Pavilion Master to collect three shares of spirit stones."]}

{"translations": ["Sanzheng? The spirit stones were painstakingly saved up by the sect—when would it ever be an outsider's turn to take them?", "The barrier has already cracked, so the spirit stones aren't safe in your hands. I will come back in three days."]}
{"translations": ["Xie Xuan let out a cold laugh, turned around, and walked away without looking back."]}
{"translations": ["When I say three days, it's three days; I never break my word."]}
{"translations": ["Elder Qin stroked his beard and glanced at Qiu Shuang, who lay asleep on the couch."]}
{"translations": ["Elder, let me go guard the barrier. Miss Chou has Yuechuan looking after her, so I can be spared.", "Finally, he gave a nod and took a jade talisman from his sleeve."]}
{"translations": ["This is the Formation Eye Token. Only by holding it can you be said to hold your Dao."]}
{"translations": ["Le Chuan stuffed the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's arms and murmured a few more reminders."]}
{"translations": ["At the mountain gate, Wan Qi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.", "Thank you, Senior Brother Wan Qi. Miss Qiu has woken up, so please convey my thanks to her."]}
{"translations": ["Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body."]}
{"translations": ["In the palace hall, Chou Shuang slowly opened her eyes."]}
{"translations": ["It's good that you're awake. You were unconscious for a whole day, so don't move around ▼"]}
{"translations": ["Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and gazed at the cracked sky outside the window.", "No one noticed that the letter in his sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal."]}

translations.1: In the early morning, the clouds and mist outside the mountain gate have not yet dispersed.
translations.10: Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin is calling you to the barrier over there. Senior Brother Moqi and I are here.
translations.11: Good. Miss Qiu has woken up, so come and call me at once.
translations.12: Wan Qi Jing scratched his head, then turned and ran back toward the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Jie Xuan stood at the palace gate, his sword still sheathed, yet the lamplight dimmed for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, it has been a long time. I have come at the order of the Pavilion Master to collect three shares of spirit stones.
translations.15: Sanzheng? The spirit stones were painstakingly saved up by the sect—when would it ever be an outsider's turn to take them?
translations.16: The barrier has already cracked, so the spirit stones aren't safe in your hands. I will come back in three days.
translations.17: Xie Xuan let out a cold laugh, turned around, and walked away without looking back.
translations.18: When I say three days, it's three days; I never break my word.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and glanced at Qiu Shuang, who lay asleep on the couch.
translations.2: Yunzhou, you've finally returned. Did you bring enough spirit stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me go guard the barrier. Miss Chou has Yuechuan looking after her, so I can be spared.
translations.21: Finally, he gave a nod and took a jade talisman from his sleeve.
translations.22: This is the Formation Eye Token. Only by holding it can you be said to hold your Dao.
translations.23: Le Chuan stuffed the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's arms and murmured a few more reminders.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, Wan Qi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother Wan Qi. Miss Qiu has woken up, so please convey my thanks to her.
translations.26: Dan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the formation-eye token close to his body.
translations.27: In the palace hall, Chou Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: It's good that you're awake. You were unconscious for a whole day, so don't move around ▼
translations.29: Qiu Shuang struggled to sit up and gazed at the cracked sky outside the window.
translations.3: I brought three bags, all of the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: No one noticed that the letter in his sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: The barrier cracked another seam last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep a wink.
translations.5: Before the words had fully left his mouth, Moqi Jing came racing up from the foot of the mountain.
translations.6: Panting, he said that a young woman was lying by the roadside at the foot of the mountain.
translations.7: Lift him up quickly. Ruoshui, go fetch the healing elixir.
translations.8: Wan Qi Jing rushed into the hall carrying an unconscious woman on his back, the iron tag at his waist engraved with: Qiu Shuang.
translations.9: The wound isn't serious, it's just that his spiritual energy is exhausted. Just feed him a Spirit-Restoring Pill.
